description: This file defines a Base64 encoding/decoding utility and an ExtJS-based exporting module for exporting grid, store, and tree data to Excel (.xls) format, including classes for workbook, worksheet, style, and cell representations.

classes.name: Ext.ux.Exporter
classes.description: Main namespace providing export functions for grid, store, and tree data.

classes.name: Ext.ux.Exporter.Button
classes.description: A specialized ExtJS button for triggering data export as downloadable Excel files.

classes.name: Ext.ux.Exporter.Formatter
classes.description: Base class for data formatters, with specific implementation for Excel.

classes.name: Ext.ux.Exporter.ExcelFormatter
classes.description: Formatter class for generating Excel (.xls) files from data stores.

classes.name: Ext.ux.Exporter.ExcelFormatter.Workbook
classes.description: Represents an Excel workbook, containing styles and worksheets.

classes.name: Ext.ux.Exporter.ExcelFormatter.Worksheet
classes.description: Represents an individual worksheet within an Excel workbook.

classes.name: Ext.ux.Exporter.ExcelFormatter.Cell
classes.description: Represents a single cell in an Excel worksheet.

classes.name: Ext.ux.Exporter.ExcelFormatter.Style
classes.description: Defines a style for cells in an Excel workbook, similar to CSS styling.

methods.name: utf8Encode
methods.description: Encodes a string into UTF-8 format.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string into Base64 format.

methods.name: addWorksheet
methods.description: Adds a worksheet to the workbook based on a data store.

methods.name: addStyle
methods.description: Adds a style to the workbook.

methods.name: compileStyles
methods.description: Compiles all styles into their XML representations.

methods.name: compileWorksheets
methods.description: Compiles all worksheets into their XML representations.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire workbook as an XML string.

methods.name: buildColumns
methods.description: Builds XML for columns in a worksheet.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds XML for a row of data.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds XML for the header row.

methods.name: buildCell
methods.description: Builds XML for a single cell.

methods.name: addDefaultStyle
methods.description: Adds default styling to the workbook.

methods.name: addTitleStyle
methods.description: Adds a style for titles.

methods.name: addHeaderStyle
methods.description: Adds a style for header cells.

methods.name: addStripedStyles
methods.description: Adds striped row styles.

methods.name: addChildNumberFormatStyle
methods.description: Adds a number format style as a child style.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Builds the XML for the worksheet.

methods.name: buildColumns
methods.description: Builds XML for columns.

methods.name: buildColumn
methods.description: Builds XML for a single column.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Builds XML for all data rows.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds XML for header row.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds XML for a data row.

methods.name: buildCell
methods.description: Builds XML for a cell with data, type, and style.
